experiments.scope: Target sha256-r55-prefix-v1 with the two-block 64-byte messages of proof Section 1. GEN_C is the normative freestanding C setup source. Before every request the organizer runs packaged Python BGen and BoundedEmitter as its byte-exact mirror, checks the 14 material C fields, the source hash, q, and the dd6815ed3e20b63da2dc2aaebf7c49d9e63852d3a7422453771050ff75a51af6 native-record hash. The Python code is a test mirror that packs logical tuples; no decoder or interpreter belongs to the priced machine. The native/wasm setup counts are participant-run accounting. Each trial runs one complete width-16 attempt with the shipped search, table, cut rule, recovery, inverse, feed-forward, and fixed second block.
experiments.hypothesis: Every returned pair contains distinct messages whose complete 55-step digests agree in the low 16 bits. Null returns are valid. Counts are program checks, not probability estimates.
